definitions.explanation: Someone who visits a home or is invited somewhere. A person being hosted.
Someone who buys goods or services from a business.

notes:
{客|きゃく} means "guest" or "customer." It's often used with polite prefixes and suffixes in service contexts.

POLITENESS LEVELS:
- {客|きゃく}: customer/guest (plain, can sound blunt)
- お{客|きゃく}さん: customer/guest (polite)
- お{客|きゃく}さま: customer/guest (very polite, service industry)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {客|きゃく}{室|しつ}: guest room
- {客|きゃく}{席|せき}: audience seating, passenger seat
- {乗客|じょうきゃく}: passenger
- {観客|かんきゃく}: spectator, audience
- {来客|らいきゃく}: visitor, guest

USAGE NOTE: In business and service contexts, using {客|きゃく} alone can sound cold or rude. お{客|きゃく}さま is standard in retail and hospitality.
